Definition: a Chamathite or native of Chamath
BiblicalUsage: The Hamathite is one of the families descended from Canaan, listed among the peoples who spread abroad after the flood.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the table of nations is there to remind me that every people, even one named in a single line, comes from the same first family.
